title: Easy Honey
description: An easy crafting recipe for honey
body:
![One of the many possible crafting recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b671dae5b216c6d74620ae2e8b613698d468b1a.png)
Adds a crafting recipe for honey bottles. To craft you can use: 
- sunflower
- wildflowers
- cornflower
- cactus flower
- torchflower
- pitcher plant
- poppy
- dandelion
- blue orchid
- allium
- azure bluet
- rose bush
- orange tulip
- pink tulip
- red tulip
- white tulip
- lilac
- peony
- oxeye daisy
- lily of the valley
- pink petals
and one bottle to get one honey bottle.
